scripts.build: python3 scripts/make_logo_hd.py && python3 scripts/build_timeline_audio.py && npm run sync
scripts.check: npm run sync && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.61 check horizontal && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.61 check vertical
scripts.render: npm run sync && npm run render:horizontal && npm run render:vertical
scripts.render:horizontal: npm run sync && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.61 render horizontal --fps 60 --quality delivery -o output/talex_tagline_horizontal.mp4
scripts.render:vertical: npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.61 render vertical --fps 60 --quality delivery -o output/talex_tagline_vertical.mp4
scripts.dev:horizontal: npm run sync && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.61 preview horizontal
scripts.dev:vertical: npm run sync && npx --yes hyperframes@0.8.61 preview vertical
